heading: Tuesday, June 16, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Moonshot AI Kimi K2.7 Code and Zhipu AI GLM-5.2.

items.headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K2.7 Code
items.summary: Kimi K2.7 Code is an open-weight coding model, with a HighSpeed variant, aimed at long-horizon agentic coding, with native image and video input. Moonshot reports 62.0 on its Kimi Code Bench V2 versus 50.9 for K2.6 and about 30% fewer thinking tokens; weights are on Hugging Face.

items.headline: Z.ai releases GLM-5.2 with 1M-token context
items.summary: GLM-5.2 is an MIT-licensed flagship for long-horizon tasks with a 1M-token context window, multiple reasoning-effort levels and an IndexShare sparse-attention design. Z.ai reports 62.1 on SWE-bench Pro and 81.0 on Terminal Bench 2.1.
